# Suwanee Gamers repository instructions

Before changing paths, content, images, audio/video, synchronization, voice,
builds, or deployment, read `docs/AI_ARCHITECTURE.md` and run
`pnpm arch:preflight` from the repository root. Trace the render, data,
automation, asset, and activation paths, including every scheduled writer. Run
the preflight again after editing plus the relevant domain tests.
